common_estimand.input: D7x5 OHLCV, seven prior UTC daily bars
common_estimand.metric: Arithmetic mean of individual-trajectory RMSE; never RMSE of ensemble mean
common_estimand.independence: One market series. Seeds are training variability conditional on the same calendar; timer repeats do not create market replicates.

RQ1.family: 10 candidates against GRU32 and Persistence;20 contrasts
RQ1.test: Registered paired circular-block temporal bootstrap centered at gain=delta; paired seed/calendar resampling as in the original engine

secondary_temporal_bootstrap_clarificati.procedure: Paired moving-block bootstrap on the full ordered common calendar, retaining all candidate/reference trajectories and regime labels for each sampled date.
secondary_temporal_bootstrap_clarificati.boundary_centering: For statistic T with null frontier b, each null replicate is b+(T_star-T_observed).
secondary_temporal_bootstrap_clarificati.seed_treatment: Recalculate each fixed trajectory metric per resample, then average equally over six trajectories. Calendar inference is conditional on these trained trajectories; any seed resampling must be reported separately.
validity_reporting: Number of dates and usable blocks in each regime
Number of valid replicates and reason for every invalid or non-estimable case
Block-length sensitivity, descriptive only unless a separate family is declared
secondary_temporal_bootstrap_clarificati.non_estimable_policy: If a stratum or paired support cannot estimate the contrast uncertainty, report non-estimable or inconclusive; never replace with zero.

RQ2.question: Does a candidate advantage over GRU32 deteriorate by more than delta in high-volatility days known at issue time?
RQ2.threshold_source: E1 training profile2023; frozen historical value, not chosen on evaluation
RQ2.estimand: d_m=g_m_normal-g_m_high, with each regime gain computed as reference mean individual RMSE minus candidate mean individual RMSE
RQ2.test: Paired temporal bootstrap of d_m, centered at d_m=delta; retain causal regime labels and recompute per-trajectory regime RMSE on each resample.
RQ2.single_contrast_decision: For a single contrast identified before its analysis, reject only for a valid one-sided p<=0.05; declare effect and interval.
RQ2.ten_candidate_decision: When communicating all10 candidates, apply Holm to the10 RQ2 p-values as its own family at0.05; reject for adjusted p<=0.05.
RQ2.reference_selection: GRU32 fixed in this later specification; not chosen from secondary results
RQ2.execution_status: No result is asserted under this later specification
RQ2.interpretation: Rejection supports relevant erosion; non-rejection does not establish robustness or equivalence.

RQ3.question: Does a candidate improve RMSE by more than delta while reducing mean inference latency versus GRU32?

minimum_effects_of_interest.cost_margin_interpretation: Directional strict reduction; no demonstrated economic or operational tolerance

RQ3.gain_component: Valid one-sided paired temporal bootstrap centered at gain=delta, under the secondary temporal specification

cost_component.test: One-sided paired-block bootstrap of mean latency differences centered at c_m=0
cost_component.comparison_policy: Use development or synthetic inputs; identical hardware, precision,batch and input support. Preserve paired session blocks and aggregate each system equally over its six predictors. Synchronize asynchronous GPU measurements.
cost_component.resampling_unit: Whole paired measurement-session block; retain candidate/reference measurements and seed mapping within each block
cost_component.readiness_gate: No cost p-value or IUT decision without comparable raw paired observations and estimable block uncertainty

RQ3.joint_p: max(p_gain,p_cost), only when both component p-values are valid
RQ3.single_contrast_decision: Both valid components must be<=0.05, equivalently p_IUT<=0.05, for one identified candidate.
RQ3.ten_candidate_decision: First form10 valid candidate IUT p-values, then apply Holm10 within RQ3 at0.05; reject for adjusted p_IUT<=0.05. Do not reuse the RQ1 Holm family or present component p-values as a third independent test.
RQ3.execution_status: Joint inferential test remains unexecuted under this specification; existing aggregate cost profiles do not resolve it.
RQ3.power_status: No RQ3-specific demonstrated power; RQ1 pilot power cannot be transferred

reporting_limits: Nominal p-values for an individual contrast must not be used to claim that any of10 candidates succeeds without the declared within-RQ adjustment.
RQ2 and RQ3 remain separate exploratory families, with no claim of global confirmatory FWER across them.
Report unadjusted and adjusted p-values, original-unit effects and uncertainty, test assumptions and non-estimable cases.
The existence of this document is not evidence of performed tests or recovered preregistration.
